column1: 21495§aspiration§ˌæspəˈreɪʃn§n. 强烈的愿望；志向§A building reflects the ideas and aspirations of the designer and client.§建筑物反映出设计者和客户的理念与渴望。
21496§considerable§kənˈsɪdərəbl§adj. 相当大（或多）的，可观的；值得考虑的，重要的§The heavy snow blocks the highway, so we have to take considerable detours.§大雪使得公路封锁，所以我们不得不绕道而行，为此多走了很多路。
21497§clumsy§ˈklʌmzi§adj. 笨拙的；不得体的§These oversized clumsy cars would slow down traffic.§这些体形硕大而笨拙的汽车会减缓交通的速度。
21498§gleam§gliːm§vi. 闪烁；流露 n. 闪光§The church steeple gleamed in the sunlight.§教堂的尖塔在阳光下闪闪发光。
21499§fascinate§ˈfæsɪneɪt§v. 强烈地吸引，使着迷§The very style of the old house fascinates.§这个老房子的风格本身就令人着迷。
21500§supervise§ˈsuːpəvaɪz§vt. 监督，管理；指导§Mary supervises the work of the department.§玛丽指导该部门的工作。
21501§evaluate§ɪˈvæljueɪt§vt. 评价，估价§We evaluated the students' skills on the basis of test results.§我们在考试成绩的基础上对学生的技能进行评估。
21502§curiosity§ˌkjʊəriˈɒsəti§n. 好奇，好奇心；稀奇或罕见之物，珍品§The relentless curiosity of scientific researchers brought the forces of nature to light.§科研人员无尽的好奇心是自然力量发现的源泉。
21503§residential§ˌrezɪˈdenʃl§adj. 居住的，住宅的；寄宿的§Smith House is one of the oldest residential colleges of the university.§史密斯学院是这所大学最古老的寄宿学院之一。
21504§sole§səʊl§adj. 唯一的，独有的 n. 鞋底，袜底；脚底§His sole motive was to make her happy.§他唯一的动机就是让她高兴。
21505§decade§ˈdekeɪd§n. 十年，十年期§In Tokyo builders are planning a massive underground city to be begun in the next decade.§在东京，建筑师们正计划在今后的十年里大规模兴建地下城。

21506§survey§ˈsɜːveɪ§n. 调查，勘察；测量，勘测；审视[səˈveɪ] vt. 调查，检视（建筑物等）；测量，勘测；俯瞰；眺望§A recent survey of staff found that 90 percent welcomed having clothing which reflected the corporate identity.§最近的一项员工调查发现，90％的员工欣然接受穿能够反映企业形象的工装。
21507§fitting§ˈfɪtɪŋ§n. 试穿；装置 adj. 适合的§If you want to buy a pair of trousers, a fitting is very necessary.§如果你想买一条裤子，试穿非常必要。
21508§rudimentary§ˌruːdɪˈmentri§adj. 基本的，初步的；未充分发展的，发育不成熟的§New staffs were given only rudimentary training at the beginning of their work.§新员工在工作之初只接受了最基本的训练。

21509§courtship§ˈkɔːtʃɪp§n. 求爱或追求；求爱期，追求期§This contact may help to maintain order within a group, and stroking or touching are part of the courtship ritual in most species.§这种接触也许有助于维持一个群体里的秩序，而在大多数物种中，抚摸或接触是求爱仪式中的一部分。
21510§ritual§ˈrɪtʃuəl§n. 典礼，（宗教等的）仪式；例行公事，老规矩 adj. 作为仪式一部分的，仪式的；例行的§It is interesting to observe, for instance, some decline in the emphasis given to marriage rituals.§我们发现很有意思的情况，例如，人们对结婚典礼的热衷程度在减弱。

21511§stereoscopic§ˌsteriəˈskɒpɪk§adj. 有立体视觉的；有立体效果的§The position of the eyes so restricts the field of vision in baleen whales that they probably do not have stereoscopic vision.§由于须鲸眼睛的位置限制了视野，它们可能没有立体视觉。
21512§interface§ˈɪntəfeɪs§n. 界面；接口；接合点§The new version of the program has a much better user interface than the original.§新版程序比旧版的用户界面要好得多。

21513§preliminary§prɪˈlɪmɪnəri§adj. 开端的，预备的，初步的 n. [常pl.] 初步做法，起始行为§Although preliminary experimental evidence suggests that their in-air vision is poor, the accuracy with which dolphins leap high to take small fish out of a trainer's hand provides evidence to the contrary.§尽管先前的试验证明海豚在空气中的视力很差，但它们可以一跃到空中获取训练者手中的小鱼，这种准确度成为与之前的结论相反的证据。

21514§turbid§ˈtɜːbɪd§adj. 浑浊的；混乱的§Vision is obviously more useful to species inhabiting clear open waters than to those living in turbid rivers and flooded plains.§显而易见，与那些生活在浑浊的小河里和河漫滩里的物种相比，视力对生活在干净清澈水域里的物种更加有用。
21515§repertoire§ˈrepətwɑː(r)§n. （剧团等）常备剧目；（剧团、演员等的）全部节目§The Royal Shakespeare Company also have many modern plays in their repertoire.§英国皇家莎士比亚剧团的常备剧目中也有很多现代剧。
21516§monotonous§məˈnɒtənəs§adj. 单调乏味的§The play became monotonous after a while.§过了一会儿，这部剧就变得单调乏味了。
21517§speculation§ˌspekjuˈleɪʃn§n. 推测，思索；投机活动，投机买卖§Rumours that the two singers are about to marry have been dismissed as pure speculation.§关于那两位歌手要结婚的谣言仅仅是猜测，无人再理会。

21518§resemble§rɪˈzembl§vt. 与…相似，相像§When we tested four totally blind volunteers using the same list, we found that their choices closely resembled those made by the sighted subjects.§当使用同样的表单对四位盲人志愿者进行测试时，我们发现他们的选择与视力正常的实验对象的选择极其相似。
21519§perspective§pəˈspektɪv§n. （判断事物的）角度，方法；透视法§We were encouraged to see the issue from a different perspective of view.§我们受到鼓励，从不同的视角来看待这个问题。
21520§rendition§renˈdɪʃn§n. （剧本、诗歌或音乐作品的）演绎，表演，演奏§The singer gave a moving rendition of the famous song “You Are Not Alone”.§这位歌手深情演绎了一首著名歌曲《你不孤单》。
21521§metaphorical§ˌmetəˈfɒrɪkl§adj. 隐喻的§The word has a literal as well as a metaphorical meaning.§这个单词有字面意思，也有隐喻义。
21522§interpret§ɪnˈtɜːprɪt§v. 诠释，解释，说明；口译，翻译§I wanted to discover whether there were differences in how the blind and the sighted interpreted colours.§我希望可以发现失明者与有视力者对颜色的描述是否有所不同。
21523§perimeter§pəˈrɪmɪtə(r)§n. 周长；周边§A river runs along one side of the field's perimeter.§小河沿着这块土地的一边延伸。
21524§jerk§dʒɜːk§v. 使猝然一动；猛拉 n. 急推，猛拉；猝然一动§He indicated the bedroom with a jerk of his head.§他用头的猝然一动示意了卧室的方向。
21525§visual§ˈvɪʒuəl§adj. 视觉的；视力的§The exhibition of London Museum is largely visual, with a huge number of items on show.§伦敦博物馆的展览会展出了大量物品，让人大开眼界。
21526§horror§ˈhɒrə(r)§n. 恐惧；恐怖§He was filled with horror at the sight of the dog.§他看见狗就不寒而栗。
21527§distort§dɪˈstɔːt§vt. 扭曲；曲解；使变形§Many people are concerned that an excessive emphasis on humanity's genetic constitution may distort our sense of values.§许多人担心过分强调人类基因构成可能会扭曲人类的价值观。
21528§expose§ɪkˈspəʊz§vt. 使暴露，揭露§He has been widely exposed on television to the public.§他经常在电视上向公众露面。
21529§sponge§spʌndʒ§n. 海绵 vt. 用湿海绵（或布）擦，揩§He squeezed out water from a sponge.§他拧出了海绵里的水。
21530§audition§ɔːˈdɪʃn§n. 试演；试听，试音§I became a professional singer after I took many auditions.§经过多次试唱，我成了一名职业歌手。
21531§reliable§rɪˈlaɪəbl§adj. 可靠的，可信赖的§Three speed cycles are simple and reliable to ride around the town.§在城里还是骑三速自行车比较简便和可靠。
21532§abstraction§æbˈstrækʃn§n. 抽象§Logic, rationality and abstraction have their origins in the left hemisphere.§逻辑、推理和抽象思维都源自大脑左半球。
21533§mount§maʊnt§n. 山，山峰；支架，底座 v. 登上；骑上；发起；镶嵌§The eruption in May 1980 of Mount St. Helens astounded the world with its violence.§1980年5月，圣海伦斯山火山爆发，其威力震惊了世界。
21534§announce§əˈnaʊns§vt. 宣布；声称§In 1989, a team of American and Canadian archaeologists announced that they had found the site of an ancient city.§1989年，一个由美国和加拿大的考古学家组成的考古小组宣布，他们发现了一处古城遗址。
21535§headline§ˈhedlaɪn§n. 大字标题；[常pl.] 头版头条新闻§What sort of national events make headlines in your country?§在贵国，哪种类型的国内事件会成为头条新闻呢？
21536§collapse§kəˈlæps§v./n. 坍塌；崩溃；晕倒§The whole market collapsed, as a matter of fact, and coffee became cheaper than it had been for the previous 25 years.§事实上，（咖啡）市场全盘崩溃，咖啡的售价跌到25年来的最低。
21537§assistance§əˈsɪstəns§n. 协助，援助§The farmers are to receive financial assistance to help see them through the severe drought .§农民们将得到经济援助，以帮助他们度过这场严重的旱灾。
21538§discriminate§dɪˈskrɪmɪneɪt§v. 区别；歧视§We must learn to discriminate right from wrong.§我们必须学会明辨是非。
21539§destructive§dɪˈstrʌktɪv§adj. 破坏（性）的§The lungs of children who grow up in polluted air offer further evidence of its destructive power.§那些呼吸着污浊空气长大的孩子们的肺部状况进一步证明，污浊空气具有毁坏性力量。
21540§authority§ɔːˈθɒrəti§n. 权力，管辖权；[pl.] 官方，当局；权威，专家§Dark colours give an aura of authority while lighter pastel shades suggest approachability.§深色调给人一种权威的感觉，而清淡柔和的色调使人感到亲切。
21541§mild§maɪld§adj. 温柔的；温和的；轻微的§The thief just got a mild punishment.§小偷只受到了轻微的惩罚。
21542§capacity§kəˈpæsəti§n. 容量，容积；能量，能力§Without genetic variability a species lacks the capacity to evolve and cannot adapt to changes in its environment.§如果没有遗传的多样性，物种就会缺乏进化的能力，也就不能适应其环境的变化。
21543§latitude§ˈlætɪtjuːd§n. 纬度；[pl.] 纬度地区；（言行等的）自由§Our position is latitude 40 degrees south.§我们的位置是南纬40度。
21544§circus§ˈsɜːkəs§n. 马戏团；环形广场§The circus trainer snapped his whip.§马戏团驯兽师把鞭子抽得啪啪响。
21545§grin§grɪn§v./n. 咧嘴笑§Sarah tried several times to catch Philip's eye, but he just grinned at her.§萨拉几次试图吸引菲利普的注意，但他只是对她咧嘴笑笑。
21546§democratic§ˌdeməˈkrætɪk§adj. 民主的；有民主精神的§The school held a democratic election for student-council officers.§学校进行了一次民主选举来挑选学生会成员。
21547§install§ɪnˈstɔːl§vt. 安顿，安置；安装，设置；正式任命，使正式就职§In the noisiest areas, mechanical ventilation will have to be installed in the exterior walls.§在最喧闹的地区，其外墙上必须安装机械通风装置。
21548§faculty§ˈfæklti§n. 才能；学院，系；（学院或系的）全体教学人员§Here on this campus we have the faculties of Architecture and Law.§这所大学里设有建筑学院和法学院。
21549§institution§ˌɪnstɪˈtjuːʃn§n. （行业）协会；机构；制度；习俗；团体；设立，制定§Such a record will allow you to present your linguistic credentials to academic institutions.§这份记录将允许你将自己的语言证书呈递给学术机构。

21550§probability§ˌprɒbəˈbɪləti§n. 可能性；概率§This is a tool for predicting the probability that a species will become extinct in a particular region over a specific period.§这是一种用来预测某一物种在某个特定时期、特定区域灭绝的可能性的工具。
21551§bizarre§bɪˈzɑː(r)§adj. 奇形怪状的；怪诞的§The story is of certain bizarre interest.§这个故事有一种怪诞的趣味。
21552§gravity§ˈgrævəti§n. 重力§This increased the arrow's stability by moving the centre of gravity to a position below the rocket.§通过将重心移到火箭下方来增加整支箭的稳定性。
21553§cap§kæp§vt. 盖在…上面 n. 帽子§The sand dredged from the waters will be used to provide a two-metre capping layer over the granite platform.§从水里挖出的沙子将被用来覆盖在大理石平台上，该覆盖层厚达两米。
21554§external§ɪkˈstɜːnl§adj. 外部的，外面的，表面的§The evidence we have suggests that domestic trade was greater than external trade at all periods.§我们掌握的证据表明，无论在哪个时期，国内贸易都要比对外贸易发达。
21555§absurd§əbˈsɜːd§adj. 荒谬的，荒唐的§Wearing a swimming suit during a snowstorm is absurd.§在暴风雪中穿泳装可真荒唐。

21556§separate§ˈsepəreɪt§v. （使）分离，（使）分开；划分，区分；分居[ˈseprət] adj. 分离的，分开的；不同的，特别的§The solution is not to separate teaching and research, but to recognize that the combination is difficult.§这种解决方案不是要将教学与研究分离开，而是承认它们的结合是困难的。
21557§inclination§ˌɪnklɪˈneɪʃn§n. 倾向；意愿；趋势；倾斜度§Developing photos requires a darkroom and the time and inclination to handle the necessary chemicals.§冲洗照片需要一间暗室、一些时间并且愿意接触冲印过程中所必需的一些化学药剂。
